description_en: Queries the SSL configurations of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterSSL接口查询集群的SSL配置情况
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterSSL

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html接口查看集群所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

ConnectionString.description_en: The endpoint that is protected by SSL encryption

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the SSL certificate expires. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ExpireTime.description_zh: SSL 证书有效期。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

SSLEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL encryption is enabled. Valid values:

true
false
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启SSL。
取值： 
true：开启。
false：关闭
